name: LVG-Bench
description:
LV-Bench Dataset
	

LV-Bench is a curated benchmark of 1,000 minute-long videos targeted at evaluating long-horizon video generation, introduced in the paper BlockVid: Block Diffusion for High-Quality and Consistent Minute-Long Video Generation.
The associated inference engine, Inferix, is detailed in the technical report Inferix: A Block-Diffusion based Next-Generation Inference Engine for World Simulation.

Project Page: https://ziplab.co/BlockVid/
Code (Inferix):… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/heyuanyu/LVG-Bench.
reputation: Introduced alongside BlockVid, LVG-Bench is recognized in the video-generation community as a challenging benchmark for minute-long synthesis but remains new with limited broad adoption.
